## Checklist

- [ ] I have read [CONTRIBUTING.md](../CONTRIBUTING.md)
- [ ] I have signed off my commits (`git commit -s`)
- [ ] My changes don't include any real production data, account IDs, or secrets
- [ ] I have verified all links still resolve
- [ ] I have verified all example values are placeholders (e.g. `example.com`, `us-east-1_XXXXXXXXX`)
- [ ] I have run the markdown linter locally
- [ ] I have updated the relevant `index.md` or table of contents if needed
- [ ] It does one thing, and is small enough to review
- [ ] If I changed code under `services/`: it has tests for what it changes, no tests were removed or switched off, and `python -m pytest tests/` passes in that service's folder

## Testing

How did you test the change? (For docs: read through the changes. For examples: did the example work?)
